protocol.stage_epe: same native512 GT and valid mask; all predicted flows interpolated to512; 16/32-grid flows multiplied by2, 64/128 unchanged
protocol.local_search: 9x9 radius4 in each feature-grid axis; nominal 512px radii 64 at32, 32 at64, 16 at128
protocol.grid_gt: area mean of valid GT, grid query retained when valid fraction>0.8
protocol.inside: max absolute x/y residual before local correlation <= nominal axis radius
protocol.bilinear_center_counterfactual: search coverage if deconv4/deconv2 were replaced by align_corners=False bilinear interpolation; the full model was NOT rerun with these replacements
protocol.detail_proxy: top quartile of visible-image Sobel magnitude among valid pixels per pair
protocol.selection: analysis only; no training or test access
